episodes.title: 39 | "Say Something!" | Surviving a Religious Cult
episodes.description: Content Warning: This episode contains discussions of sexual abuse, suicide, trauma, child abuse, religious abuse, and mental health struggles. Please listen with care. What happens when the place that's supposed to protect you becomes the place that causes the deepest harm? In this powerful episode of Where We Rise, Khalila sits down with Heather Ford, author of The Barbie Pink Walls That Kept My Secrets of Abuse, to discuss her experience growing up in a group she describes as a Christian cult. Heather shares how religious control, spiritual manipulation, isolation, and sexual abuse shaped her childhood, and how she eventually found the courage to break her silence after years of carrying the weight of those experiences alone. Together, they explore difficult but important topics including religious trauma, purity culture, child abuse, survivor advocacy, mental health, and the lasting impact of being silenced. Heather also opens up about losing her sister to suicide, writing her memoir, and why speaking the truth became more important than staying comfortable. This conversation is not about one church, one denomination, or one organization. It's about what can happen when accountability disappears, vulnerable people are ignored, and harmful behavior is protected instead of confronted. Whether you're a survivor, someone who loves a survivor, a person of faith, or simply someone who believes every child deserves to be safe, this episode will challenge you to think deeply about courage, responsibility, and what it means to speak up when something isn't right.
